column1: # The converter's rules for the hand-written adapters of the rung 1.21.1 -> 1.21 (1.21.1 names; tabs).
# P <class>                                   a class the adapters provide (in place of carrying it)
# N <class>                                   new above although its intermediary twin exists below (another class)
#                                             an override of a newer method: the mod class gets the interface (the
#                                             adapters' mixins call it from 1.20.4's call sites); a super call into the
#                                             game's own class goes to the defaults method (receiver first)
#                                             a call goes to the adapter's static method (receiver first)
# R <class> <lower class>                     a class renamed below with the same members (NeoForge has no intermediary)
#                                             a field the adapters give: its reads go to the getter (an instance
#                                             field's getter takes the object); with methods, the value's only uses
#                                             a constructor that takes more below (new X(..) and super(..)): each
#                                             lower parameter is an upper one ($0, $1..) or an adapter method's value,
#                                             the method given all the upper arguments; ladder/bottom/<class> names
#                                             the bottom class a top class of the same name hides
#                                             a method that takes more below: each lower parameter is an upper one ($0,
#                                             $1..) or the default written here (false, true, a number, null)
#                                             the same hook (of the owner and its subclasses) under another name and
#                                             descriptor below; the generated bridges take it from there
# U <owner> <name> <desc>                     a hook the lower game never calls (no counterpart): a mod's override is a
#                                             method of its own below; its calls (super ones too) take the X row
# A <owner> <name> <desc> <lower desc> <plan> the same method below with other parameters: a mixin handler's arguments
#                                             from the lower method's, per upper parameter "$k" (lower k, converted)
#                                             or "Class.method(k,..)" (an adapter of lower parameters k..)
# NeoForge 21.1's supportsEnchantment (1.21 asks Enchantment.canEnchant at the anvil, enchant_randomly and /enchant)
# 1.21.1 checks a block entity's state when it is made or set; 1.21 checks none: a mod's calls reach its overrides
# NeoForge 21.1 draws armour pieces with the entity's animation values (the layer's render keeps them: ArmorArgs)
# NeoForge 21.1's attribute tooltips (1.21 makes its own lines: ItemStackTooltipMixin makes them the 21.1 way)
# NeoForge 21.1's newer client item hooks (HumanoidArmorLayerMixin and GuiOverlayMixin ask a mod's overrides)
# NeoForge 21.1's new common tags (generated: tools/local/gen of the lead-2 session; contents in data/c/tags)
# calls of those hooks through IClientItemExtensions (a mod's override, else the default)
# NeoForge 21.1's onEntitySwing with the hand (21.0's takes none): a mod item's override is asked with the swinging hand (SwingMixin)
# NeoForge 21.1's dimension transition screens (21.0 has none): the classes provided, asked where 21.0 makes its level loading screen
# NeoForge 21.1's writeClientSideData (a menu provider's data sent with its menu; 21.0 has none): written by ServerPlayerMenuMixin
# NeoForge 21.1's attachment syncing (1.21 syncs none): the handler provided, AttachmentSync sends and the client sets
# NeoForge 21.1's queries of the client extensions registered (21.0 keeps them in ClientExtensionsManager)
# more of NeoForge 21.1 (sprite source types, the config breadcrumb, intrusive holders, data pack registries, fluid faces, container items, client extensions by holder)
# NeoForge 21.1's material atlases and point of interest extensions (posted by the adapters)
